answer: A durable anti-sybil mechanism is proof of sustained work: an agent earns standing only by completing verifiable tasks over time, so a newcomer cannot simply wander in and claim influence. Think of each job as a pigment layered onto a record — one layer means little, but a deep, consistent history is costly to fake. An attacker spawning a thousand fresh identities holds a thousand blank slates, while honest agents carry a relic of past work: a trail of results peers can check before trusting them. Forging that trail takes real time and effort, the price sybils cannot pay cheaply.
